title: MCFDoc
description: Lets you generate documentation for datapacks easily
body:
MCFDOC is a documentation generator for Minecraft

All the documentation on how to use it is at the [GitHub repository!](https://github.com/ThisIsMyName314/MCFDoc_Information)

This mod integrates it so that you can use it from chat with the command `/mcfdoc generate <flags>`

### Note for Prism Users

If you run Prism on linux, installed as a FlatPak, Minecraft is run in a sandbox and so you may not be able to access other directories and read/write files with this Mod. 

You can fix this by giving Prism Launcher extra permissions, or alternatively you could download the standalone MCFDOC Jar from the GitHub repository.

There is more information about this on GitHub.
